text:
kevin (Customer): Hey team — customers on prod are seeing chat streams terminate early. The client gets a partial SSE event, then connection closes and client reconnects, sometimes repeatedly. Happening ~5% of sessions, spikes during low traffic windows. No 4xx from our side.

maria (Support): Sorry you're hitting this, kevin. Can you paste a raw response snippet + client repro steps? Is there any CDN/edge in front? :thinking_face:

kevin (Customer): Repro steps:
1) Open websocket-like SSE request to https://chat.example.com/v1/stream with a long prompt
2) Wait ~45-90s, stream stops mid-token, connection resets on client with ECONNRESET
3) client reconnects and resumes but gets duplicate prefix sometimes
Curl to reproduce (what we used):
```bash
curl -v -N -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  "https://chat.example.com/v1/stream?model=redwood-small" 
```
Response log shows last bytes: `data: {"delta":"\u001b[0m"}` then socket close.
We have Cloudflare in front and ALB behind it. Token is ok — we rotate but saw same behaviour on fresh token.

maria (Support): Thanks. I see similar reports yesterday from another customer. @ben can you check our ALB/ext proxy idle timeout + keepalive config? Might be truncation due to proxy buffering or half-close.

ben (Eng-Infra): Looking. ALB idle timeout is 60s by default in our infra; we set 120s in most routes but this cluster is still on 60s. However ALB usually sends FIN not RESET. Envoy/nginx upstream configs also matter. Do we have NLB in some stacks? any TCP proxy in front of app pods?

alex (Eng-Platform): Cloudflare (Argo) is configured with http2-to-1.1 proxying on that domain. CF will prune idle connections aggressively unless we emit keepalive bytes. Our runtime sends SSE comment heartbeats `: keepalive\n\n` every 25s normally, but I see in logs for that customer their requests had `Accept: text/event-stream` and our runtime switched to chunked encoding without keepalives because of request size heuristics. Possible race: CF/ALB idle timers + suppressed keepalive = midstream close.

linda (SRE): Also saw a cluster of 401s around reconnects in the logs — token checker returned 200 on initial request but 401 on subsequent resume attempts. Could be token rotation expiration TTL on the client side + reconnects triggering auth failure, leading to abrupt close. Need correlation: is client resending old token or using short-lived token?

kevin (Customer): Client uses SDK with auto-refresh, but token rotate happens server-side every 2 minutes for security. We tested with a long-lived token and still saw truncation. Attached server side logs: last chunk length 128 then FIN. No 401 in that run.

maria (Support): Ok — two hypotheses: (A) proxy idle/buffering (ALB/Cloudflare/nginx) dropping connection when no bytes for Xs, and our runtime not sending heartbeats in that codepath; (B) middle proxy doing HTTP/1.1 pipe buffering that waits for full chunk then forces reset on half-close.

ben (Eng-Infra): Quick checks I ran:
- tcpdump on node -> saw FIN from ALB after ~65s of inactivity (client saw reset because TCP half-close timeline mismatched).
- Envoy access logs show last upstream byte then upstream_idle_timeout hit.
- Nginx in edge stack had `proxy_buffering on` and `proxy_read_timeout 60s` in one cluster.

alex (Eng-Platform): Repro script I used locally behind CF+ALB: I sent a small output event then paused server for 70s. CF connection closed at 60s. When server resumed, client got truncated stream. Code snippet we used to send keepalive from runtime:
```js
res.write(': heartbeat\\n\\n'); // flush comment to keep proxies alive
```
If that isn't emitted by runtime when using certain batching modes, proxies will drop.

kevin (Customer): Is there a recommended workaround short-term? We can switch to polling but want streaming.

maria (Support): Short-term options:
- Configure CF no-tunnel / disable aggressive idle pruning (depends on plan)
- Set ALB idle timeout higher (120-300s) for affected target groups
- Add client-side exponential reconnect with de-duplication (idempotency token) to avoid duplicate tokens
- Force runtime to emit periodic `: heartbeat` comments more frequently (eg every 20s)

linda (SRE): For us, longer-term: make runtime always emit heartbeats for any SSE path, not just when payloads are small. Also ensure our load balancer timeouts are uniform (CF -> ALB -> Envoy) and documented. I'll open an infra ticket to normalize `proxy_read_timeout` and ALB idle to 180s.

ben (Eng-Infra): Filed INF-2193 to roll ALB idle timeout change for that cluster and update terraform. Also changing nginx `proxy_read_timeout` to 180s and `proxy_buffering off` for /v1/stream routes. Will coordinate with infra deploy.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: infra/nginx config update -> canary -> full. ETA canary in 2 hours, full rollout 6 hours. :rocket:

alex (Eng-Platform): I'll push a small runtime hotfix to force heartbeats every 20s for streaming endpoints and add a feature flag to revert if it causes issues. PR ready -> will coordinate with deploy window.

kevin (Customer): Thanks — we'll try the client-side de-dupe and keep you posted. If you want packet captures from our side I can provide pcap. Also can test long-lived token run again if you change LB.

maria (Support): Please send a pcap and one example request id when you have it. Marking this P1 for now given user impact. We'll update here after the infra canary.

ben (Eng-Infra): Can we also check Cloudflare's `origin_keepalive_timeout` and `http2` settings? If CF drops HTTP/2 stream and we demote to HTTP/1.1 we can see different behavior.

alex (Eng-Platform): Good point. Noted to check CF preserve-origin-connection and to add explicit `Connection: keep-alive` hints in the SSE responses. Also tracking metric: sse_disconnects / total_sse_sessions to see impact.

kevin (Customer): FYI — after we enabled client heartbeat (sends 1 byte `\\n` every 25s) we saw a drop in truncations during our small test. Might be enough as interim. We'll still want server fixes.

maria (Support): Great, thank you. Action items summary:
- ben: INF-2193 ALB/nginx timeout & buffering changes (canary in 2h)
- alex: runtime heartbeat hotfix + flag (PR + coordinate deploy)
- kevin: provide pcap + example request id
- linda: monitor SSE disconnect metric and set alert threshold
Will keep thread updated. :white_check_mark:
